import sys
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools")
import bl_authority as a
def cl(q,t=None):return a.class_reasons({"touches":t or []},{"id":"g1","question":q,"options":["one","two"]})[0]
ident=[cl("Gate and bare_token move to ql_learn; def_tokens is left with no caller"),cl("Does the helper bare_token stay in kbcommon?")]
real=[cl(q) for q in ("Rotate the API token of the service account?","Where is the GITLAB_TOKEN kept?","Store the credential file in _private?","Should the secret be kept in a vault?")]
print("code identifier gates:",ident,"| token, secret and credential gates:",real)
sys.exit(0 if "secrets" not in ident and all(r=="secrets" for r in real) else 1)
